mapper.select: SELECT tk.id, tk.code, tk.type, tk.status, tk.from_status, tk.to_status, a.account_number, c.full_name AS customer_name, c.email AS customer_email, creator.full_name AS creator_name, creator.email AS creator_email, (SELECT h.note FROM app.ticket_history h WHERE h.ticket_id = tk.id AND h.action = 'REJECTED' ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS reject_reason FROM app.ticket tk JOIN app.employee creator ON creator.id = tk.created_by LEFT JOIN app.account a ON a.id = tk.account_id LEFT JOIN app.customer c ON c.id = a.customer_id WHERE tk.id = #{ticketId}
SELECT full_name, email FROM app.employee WHERE id = #{employeeId}
